description: Keep Our Promise to VeteransWhen someone signs up to serve, they’re making a commitment to this country.They’re putting their life on hold. They’re accepting risk most of us will never face. They’re stepping into something bigger than themselves.We ask a lot of them.The least we can do is keep our promise when they come home.I’m running for Congress because too many veterans are still fighting—just in a different way.They’re fighting to get an appointment. Fighting to access mental health care.F
